head_commit.message:
Fix Studio 2020 import stability and original-model/movie acceptance

Retain the original GLB guard alongside the explicit facial derivative. Canonicalize only Godot-generated eyelid import fields. Set capture-only MovieMaker dimensions before writer initialization and preserve the strict 640x640 roster with an additional negative fixture.

The failed 8be3 CI remains recorded. Targeted original red/green and actual new movie proofs are documented; a fresh complete native run remains required. Production project defaults, assets, old workflows and Main are unchanged.
